segments.name: Inpatient Services
segments.description: Operates skilled nursing, assisted and independent living facilities and behavioral health hospitals, providing inpatient care to seniors and other patients.
segments.evidence: The Company has two reportable operating segments: (1) inpatient services, which includes the operation of skilled nursing facilities, assisted and independent living facilities, and behavioral health hospitals and (2) homecare and hospice services.

segments.name: Homecare and Hospice
segments.description: Provides home health and hospice services, including palliative care, to patients who remain at home or in assisted living residences.
segments.evidence: Caris specializes in providing hospice and palliative care to over 1,647 patients per day in 33 locations in Georgia, Missouri, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Virginia.

segments.name: All Other
segments.description: Rents healthcare properties, provides management, accounting and insurance services to other operators, and carries corporate office costs.
segments.evidence: The Company also reports an "all other" category that includes revenues from rental income, management and accounting services fees, insurance services, and costs of the corporate office.

revenueModel.text: Patients and their payers, chiefly Medicare, Medicaid, managed care and private pay, pay for skilled nursing, senior living, homecare, hospice and behavioral health care.
revenueModel.evidence: Private paying patients, private insurance carriers and the Veterans Administration generally pay based on the center's charges or specifically negotiated contracts.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company sold its joint venture ownership interest in a homecare agency located in Nashville, Tennessee.
changes.evidence: In January 2024, the Company sold its 50 % joint venture ownership interest in a homecare agency located in Nashville, Tennessee.
